decks.notes: This deck aims to efficiently search for and cast the card Doomsday, followed by assembling a winning combination of cards that lead to victory in a single turn. It utilizes a combination of card draw, mana acceleration, and control elements like counterspells to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The key strategy is to carefully plan out the order of cards within the Doomsday pile to ensure a successful and efficient win condition. Additionally, the deck includes alternate win conditions like Thassa's Oracle and Demonic Consultation for additional flexibility.

This Vintage 1 vs 1 Aggro deck focuses on utilizing cards like Basking Rootwalla, Blazing Rootwalla, and Deathrite Shaman to quickly overwhelm opponents with creature pressure. By utilizing cards like Stitcher's Supplier and Once Upon a Time to quickly fill the graveyard, the deck aims to bring back powerful threats like Hogaak, Arisen Necropolis and Vengevine. With additional disruption from Force of Vigor and strong mana acceleration from ramp cards like Black Lotus and Mox Emerald, this deck aims to win the game quickly and aggressively.

This deck focuses on aggressively using discard outlets like Basking Rootwalla and Blazing Rootwalla to put powerful creatures like Hollow One and Vengevine into play quickly. It leverages Force of Will and Force of Negation to protect its threats, while also utilizing disruptive spells like Mindbreak Trap to control the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of Bazaar of Baghdad allows the deck to dig through its library to find key cards, making it extremely efficient at executing its game plan. Additionally, Noxious Revival ensures that important cards can be brought back from the graveyard when needed.

The main concept of this deck revolves around controlling the game through various spells and planeswalkers, while using Oath of Druids to potentially quickly bring out powerful creatures like Griselbrand or Serra's Emissary. The deck includes a range of counterspells and card draw to maintain control over the board, as well as disruptive cards like Ashiok, Dream Render and Narset, Parter of Veils. The deck also includes some powerful tutors like Demonic Tutor and Vampiric Tutor to find key cards when needed. The overall strategy is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while establishing a strong board presence.

The deck focuses on disruption and controlling the game through the use of powerful creatures and powerful spells. It capitalizes on the strength of cards like Wrenn and Six, Collector Ouphe, and Deathrite Shaman, while also utilizing disruptive spells like Force of Will and Force of Vigor. The deck aims to slow down the opponent's game plan, while generating card advantage through Standstill and other draw spells. By disrupting the opponent and controlling the board, the deck seeks to out-value the opponent and eventually secure victory.

The deck focuses on combining artifact cards with blue spells to generate powerful card advantage and control the game. It utilizes key artifacts such as Moxen, Time Vault, and Bolas's Citadel to enable explosive plays and win conditions. The inclusion of powerful blue spells like Ancestral Recall, Tinker, and Force of Will further emphasizes the deck's ability to manipulate the game state and outmaneuver opponents. By leveraging a combination of artifact synergy and blue control elements, this deck aims to create a dominant position on the battlefield and secure victory through its powerful combos and card advantage engine.

This deck focuses on disrupting opponents while maintaining card advantage through efficient removal spells and card draw. It utilizes control elements like Force of Will and Force of Negation to protect key threats like Dark Confidant and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion allows for additional value through recurring smaller permanents. The deck also features powerful draw spells like Ancestral Recall and Treasure Cruise to ensure a steady stream of resources, while also having versatile removal options like Lightning Bolt and Wasteland to handle threats efficiently.

This deck focuses on disrupting opponents with various hate cards like Collector Ouphe and Leovold, while also applying pressure through efficient threats like Tarmogoyf and Oko, Thief of Crowns. The deck also utilizes powerful blue spells and card draw like Ancestral Recall and Treasure Cruise to maintain tempo and card advantage. The inclusion of disruption spells like Force of Will and Assassin's Trophy help protect the deck's gameplan while also handling opposing threats. The mana base is well-tuned to support the deck's color requirements and to disrupt the opponent with cards like Wasteland and Strip Mine.

This deck focuses on leveraging artifacts and powerful spells to generate a massive amount of mana and draw cards quickly. Using cards like Paradoxical Outcome and Tinker, the player can quickly assemble powerful combos to overwhelm their opponent. The deck also includes control elements like Force of Will and Flusterstorm to protect their game plan. By combining card draw, mana acceleration, and powerful artifact synergies, the deck aims to create explosive turns and win the game before the opponent has a chance to react.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with creatures such as Basking Rootwalla, Blazing Rootwalla, and Vengevine to enable powerful plays like recurring Bloodghast and bringing back Hogaak, Arisen Necropolis. Stitcher's Supplier and Once Upon a Time help to fuel this strategy, while cards like Hollow One provide additional aggressive threats. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Force of Vigor and a compact mana base with cards like Bazaar of Baghdad and fetch lands to support the aggressive game plan.

The deck focuses on utilizing graveyard synergies to quickly and aggressively overwhelm the opponent. By using cards like Bazaar of Baghdad and Stitcher's Supplier to fill the graveyard, the deck can bring back powerful creatures like Hogaak, Arisen Necropolis and Vengevine. It also includes disruptive elements like Force of Vigor to deal with opposing threats. The deck aims to win the game through swift and relentless aggression, taking advantage of its graveyard resources to maintain pressure on the opponent.

This deck focuses on utilizing powerful blue spells and disruptive creatures to control the opponent's resources while applying pressure with efficient threats. By using Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion, the deck gains access to recurring low-cost creatures and spells, allowing for constant pressure and disruption. With a combination of powerful counterspells, disruptive creatures like Collector Ouphe, and card advantage engines like Jace, Vryn's Prodigy, the deck aims to slow down the opponent's game plan while presenting a fast clock to close out the game.

The deck focuses on using Underworld Breach to combo off and cast a large number of spells in a single turn, winning the game through card advantage and overwhelming the opponent. The deck includes tutors, cantrips, and powerful spells to generate mana and dig through the library quickly. It utilizes various disruptive cards like Force of Will and Pyroblast to protect the combo and control the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to quickly assemble the combo pieces and execute the combo for a decisive victory before the opponent can mount a defense.

This deck revolves around utilizing artifacts and spells to generate card advantage and mana, eventually leading to a game-winning combo using Paradoxical Outcome. The deck includes various mana rocks and accelerants like Moxen and Tolarian Academy to power out spells quickly, while also including disruption in the form of counterspells like Force of Will and Mental Misstep. Key cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Bolas's Citadel provide additional utility and win condition options. The deck aims to efficiently control the game until it can assemble its combo pieces for a decisive victory.

The deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo involving Coveted Jewel and various mana accelerants like Moxen and Grim Monolith. The goal is to generate large amounts of mana quickly to cast spells like Paradoxical Outcome and Tinker to find key pieces like Time Vault. Karn, the Great Creator can also shut down opponent's artifacts while enabling the combo. The deck looks to establish a dominant board presence and overwhelm the opponent with powerful artifacts and card advantage, ultimately winning the game through a decisive combo finish.

This deck relies on utilizing Bazaar of Baghdad to quickly fill up the graveyard with cards like Basking Rootwalla and Vengevine, allowing for explosive starts and aggressive plays. The deck also features a strong suite of free counterspells in Force of Will, Force of Negation, and Mindbreak Trap to disrupt opponents' strategies. Additionally, the deck includes powerful graveyard recursion with cards like Squee, Goblin Nabob and Master of Death to maintain pressure on the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Hollow One and Blazing Rootwalla also provide additional threats and versatility to the deck's game plan.
